name: supervisor-workspace-mvp
description: Offline Windows workspace for student learning records
author: Supervisor Workspace

scripts.build: node scripts/build-recovery.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && vite build --base ./
scripts.test: node scripts/build-recovery.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node --test test/*.test.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run pack:win:dir
